what: Text-to-3D props for the repite-y-tranca colmado (corner shop) scene.
art_direction: stylized toon cartoon game art, rounded simple shapes, clean matte colors, big expressive appeal, friendly mobile-game look

pipeline.generate: tripo make "<prompt>"  (text-to-3D, v3.1-20260211, 20 credits each; no rigging needed or attempted for props)

common.orientation: Y-up, centred on the origin, longest side normalised to 1.0 unit by Tripo.
common.bounds_source: gltf-transform decoded positions (meshopt + int16 quantisation) summed over every vertex in world space; cross-checked against three.js Box3 in the preview page.
common.texture_budget: 1024 px, webp, ORM + normal map kept

performance_warning.issue: Every asset is ~710k-750k triangles because v3.1 geometry is dense and --simplify-ratio 0.5 only halves it (hand source 1,498,606 tris -> 749,302; props ~1.45M -> ~720k each). Roughly 5.0M triangles for the 7 shipped assets, plus three 1024 px texture sets each.
performance_warning.why: The optimize command in the brief pins --simplify-ratio 0.5, which was followed exactly.
performance_warning.fix_if_needed: Re-run the same optimize command at a lower ratio for web, e.g. --simplify-ratio 0.1 (~150k tris) or 0.05 (~75k tris), or decimate further with 'npx -y @gltf-transform/cli simplify <in.glb> <out.glb> --ratio 0.1'. Costs no credits.

props.name: shelf
props.prompt: stylized toon cartoon game prop, rounded simple shapes, clean matte colors, friendly mobile game style: a wooden wall shelf unit stocked with stacked domino boxes and a few glass bottles

bounds_world_units.note: Y-up, centred on origin; longest side normalised to 1.0 unit by Tripo.

props.visual_verdict: VERY GOOD. Reads instantly as a colmado wall shelf: three wooden shelves, stacked domino boxes with visible pips, teal glass bottles and a small jar, thick rounded toon timber. Nothing floats. Content faces +X; the flat back panel is at -X, so set it against a wall at -X (or rotate).
props.usage_note: Front/contents face +X (depth 0.361 on X); back panel at -X. Put the back at -X against a wall.

props.name: radio
props.prompt: stylized toon cartoon game prop, rounded simple shapes, clean matte colors, friendly mobile game style: an old portable radio with a round speaker grille and two knobs

bounds_world_units.note: Y-up, centred on origin; longest side normalised to 1.0 unit by Tripo.

props.visual_verdict: GOOD. Clearly a chunky retro portable radio: round black speaker grille in a white bezel, two knobs, a carry handle, a dark top button. Slightly glossier and more saturated than 'clean matte', but firmly in friendly mobile-game territory. Face is +X.
props.usage_note: Face (grille + knobs) is +X; depth 0.578 on X, width 1.000 on Z, height 0.771 on Y.

props.name: crate
props.prompt: stylized toon cartoon game prop, rounded simple shapes, clean matte colors, friendly mobile game style: a wooden crate of glass soda bottles

bounds_world_units.note: Y-up, centred on origin; longest side normalised to 1.0 unit by Tripo.

props.visual_verdict: EXCELLENT. Open slatted wooden crate holding seven teal glass soda bottles with orange caps; the glass read is convincing and every bottle sits properly on the crate floor. Almost exactly cubic (1.000 x 0.988 x 0.993).
props.usage_note: Sits flat on -Y; open top faces +Y.

props.name: lamp
props.prompt: stylized toon cartoon game prop, rounded simple shapes, clean matte colors, friendly mobile game style: a plain hanging pendant light, a simple dark enamel dome lamp shade over a bare glass light bulb, thin straight cord going up, no face, no eyes, no mouth, no smile, no decoration

bounds_world_units.note: Y-up, centred on origin; longest side normalised to 1.0 unit by Tripo.

props.visual_verdict: GOOD and clean: slate enamel dome, bare cream bulb below, thin cord above, no face. The dome is wide relative to the cord (0.993 x 1.000 x 0.998) so it reads as a big counter pendant; the slimmer first attempt is kept as lamp-alt-web.glb if a longer drop is wanted.
props.usage_note: Hangs from -Y: cord top at y = +0.50, bulb bottom at y = -0.50. Suspension point is the cord end at +Y.

alternate.note: first attempt; Tripo put an unrequested smiley face on the bulb. Otherwise a nicer slimmer pendant (size 0.475 x 1.000 x 0.468). Shipped the face-free regen instead.

props.name: fan
props.prompt: stylized toon cartoon game prop, rounded simple shapes, clean matte colors, friendly mobile game style: a simple ceiling fan seen from directly underneath, three flat wooden blades radiating horizontally in a star shape from a small round hub, short straight ceiling rod on top, no wall mount, no fan cage, no guard

bounds_world_units.note: Y-up, centred on origin; longest side normalised to 1.0 unit by Tripo.

props.visual_verdict: MIXED — the weakest item. It is a clean all-wood fan with rounded toon blades (no plastic parts, good matte colour), but it is a 4-blade fan whose blade disc faces +X with a stem out the back, NOT the requested 3-blade horizontal ceiling fan. Fix cheaply: rotate it -90 deg about Z (rotation.z = -Math.PI/2) so the stem points up to the ceiling and the blades lie horizontal. Two separate text generations both returned 4 blades, so treat 'three blades' as unmet; deleting one blade by hand or accepting four are the options.
props.usage_note: Blade disc faces +X. Apply rotation.z = -Math.PI/2 to hang it as a ceiling fan (stem up, blades horizontal).

alternate.note: first attempt; 4 blades, orange wood plus a blue hub and a cream dome with a white mounting plate. Kept as a look alternate.

props.name: stool
props.prompt: stylized toon cartoon game prop, rounded simple shapes, clean matte colors, friendly mobile game style: a tall wooden shop stool with four legs

bounds_world_units.note: Y-up, centred on origin; longest side normalised to 1.0 unit by Tripo.

props.visual_verdict: GOOD. A tall wooden stool with four legs (counted in the front views), a round seat with a purple cushion and yellow cross-rungs, rounded feet. Colours are more saturated and 'sporty' than clean matte, but it is appealing and unmistakably a shop stool.
props.usage_note: Stands on -Y; seat top at y = +0.50. 0.760 x 1.000 x 0.773 — about 0.76 m wide for a 1.0 m tall stool.
